title: Red Hat Security Advisory: nodejs:22 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Red Hat has issued an important security advisory for the nodejs:22 module in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8, addressing multiple vulnerabilities in Node.js and its dependencies. The update fixes several denial of service issues in the brace-expansion and undici libraries, certificate validation bypasses, cache poisoning, and DNS hostname truncation bugs. These vulnerabilities could lead to denial of service, information disclosure, and TLS certificate validation bypass. The advisory includes a rebase to the latest Node.js 22 release for RHEL 8. Users are advised to apply the update to mitigate these issues.
